cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(threshold_emp_ag_wrk LANGUAGES CXX)
find_package(emp-tool 1.0 CONFIG REQUIRED)
find_package(OpenSSL REQUIRED COMPONENTS Crypto)
add_library(emp_ag_wrk INTERFACE)
add_library(emp-ag::wrk ALIAS emp_ag_wrk)
target_compile_features(emp_ag_wrk INTERFACE cxx_std_20)
target_include_directories(emp_ag_wrk INTERFACE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
target_link_libraries(emp_ag_wrk INTERFACE emp-tool::emp-tool OpenSSL::Crypto)
option(EMP_AG_ENABLE_GMW "Build the distributed authenticated preprocessing interface" ON)
if(EMP_AG_ENABLE_GMW)
  set(EMP_AG_OT_BACKEND "SoftSpoken" CACHE STRING "COT extension used by distributed GMW (SoftSpoken: fastest; Ferret: ~28% less offline traffic, ~3.5x slower, +300 MB/party)")
  set_property(CACHE EMP_AG_OT_BACKEND PROPERTY STRINGS Ferret SoftSpoken IKNP)
  if(EMP_AG_OT_BACKEND STREQUAL "Ferret")
    set(emp_ag_ot_backend_id 2)
  elseif(EMP_AG_OT_BACKEND STREQUAL "SoftSpoken")
    set(emp_ag_ot_backend_id 1)
  elseif(EMP_AG_OT_BACKEND STREQUAL "IKNP")
    set(emp_ag_ot_backend_id 0)
  else()
    message(FATAL_ERROR "EMP_AG_OT_BACKEND must be Ferret, SoftSpoken, or IKNP")
  endif()
  find_package(emp-ot 1.0 CONFIG REQUIRED)
  add_library(emp_ag_gmw INTERFACE)
  add_library(emp-ag::gmw ALIAS emp_ag_gmw)
  target_link_libraries(emp_ag_gmw INTERFACE emp-ag::wrk emp-ot::emp-ot)
  target_compile_definitions(emp_ag_gmw INTERFACE EMP_AG_OT_BACKEND=${emp_ag_ot_backend_id})
  set(EMP_AG_TRIPLE_BACKEND "HalfGate" CACHE STRING "Checked Boolean triple provider")
  set_property(CACHE EMP_AG_TRIPLE_BACKEND PROPERTY STRINGS HalfGate FKOS)
  if(EMP_AG_TRIPLE_BACKEND STREQUAL "FKOS")
    target_compile_definitions(emp_ag_gmw INTERFACE EMP_AG_TRIPLE_BACKEND=1)
    set(emp_ag_default_batch 350000)
  elseif(EMP_AG_TRIPLE_BACKEND STREQUAL "HalfGate")
    target_compile_definitions(emp_ag_gmw INTERFACE EMP_AG_TRIPLE_BACKEND=0)
    set(emp_ag_default_batch 8192)
  else()
    message(FATAL_ERROR "EMP_AG_TRIPLE_BACKEND must be HalfGate or FKOS")
  endif()
  set(EMP_AG_GMW_TRIPLE_BATCH_SIZE ${emp_ag_default_batch} CACHE STRING "Maximum GMW triple output batch")
  target_compile_definitions(emp_ag_gmw INTERFACE EMP_AG_GMW_TRIPLE_BATCH_SIZE=${EMP_AG_GMW_TRIPLE_BATCH_SIZE})
  message(STATUS "Authenticated GMW COT backend: ${EMP_AG_OT_BACKEND}")
  message(STATUS "Authenticated GMW triple backend: ${EMP_AG_TRIPLE_BACKEND}")
endif()
